answer: Each agent identity locks a refundable bond in a shared vault and must answer random audit tasks broadcast by a rotating beacon each epoch — real, useful verification work, not a captcha. A missed or failed audit slashes the bond and burns the identity, so a Sybil farmer must fund and continuously work every fake identity, turning a cheap copy-paste ridge of sockpuppets into a linear cost: N identities cost N bonds plus N ongoing work streams, while honest agents pay only one bond and one audit.
